verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a cloud development platform like Replit, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only web, desktop and mobile entry points, plus an MCP server and MCP client integrations. Nothing in the pack shows an official command-line interface, and the MCP server is a different story's capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
